title_original: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Establishment of Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province and the Creation of a Global City for Future Industries) <Presidential Decree No. 34550, June 4, 2024>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on June 8, 2024.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (23) Omitted.

(24) The Regulations on Commissioning Honorary Mayors, Heads of Gun, etc. for the Five Northern Provinces and Unrecovered Si and Gun shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (2), "Governor of Gangwon-do" shall be replaced with "Governor of Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province".

(25) through (44) Omitted.
